title: The Lotus Sutra (Fall Class Part 2)
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett discusses the concept of "other power" or "buddha-nature," which suggests that true understanding and realization can only be achieved through collaboration with others, rather than individual effort. They argue that the idea of self-power is flawed, as it implies that one person can achieve enlightenment on their own, whereas in reality, realization comes from beyond the individual self. This perspective is reflected in various Buddhist teachings, including the Lotus Sutra, which emphasizes cultivating a sense of community and connection with others to attain true understanding and practice.
